{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/quenching/brief/tasks/magnesium_quenching_trial_3/quench.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Mg quenching

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/quenching/brief/tasks/magnesium_quenching_trial_3/mg.data

# EAM potential for Mg
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Mg_Sun.eam.alloy Mg

# Initial minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Set timestep
timestep 0.001

# Create velocity
velocity all create 2000 12345 dist gaussian

# NPT quench from 2000K to 300K
fix 1 all npt temp 2000 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal
dump 1 all custom 1000 dump.quench id type x y z

run 20000

unfix 1
undump 1

# NPT relaxation at 300K
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000

unfix 2

# NVT relaxation at 300K
fix 3 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run 10000

# Output final density
variable dens equal density
print "Final_density: ${dens}""}
